text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the view count shot way up again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can totally see why, looking at 
this Ines.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It really makes you want to run, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, excuse me. It's my first time 
coming to Tracen Island."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try training, do I need to 
register at the reception or something?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll show ya the way! Over this way~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The commercial was a massive hit, and 
ever since, many Umamusume have been 
visiting Tracen Island!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—the fateful day to decide the 
operational policy for Tracen Island had 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Before I open this, just let me say 
this one thing!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
No matter what the conclusion may be, 
these past three years have been 
immensely, truly meaningful to me...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"I was the one who asked the Chairwoman 
for the Umamusumes' help. Between 
pioneering and the trials, we needed the 
strength of active racers!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"...However! Who would have thought it'd 
be this hard to say goodbye!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I asked for help with pioneering, gathered 
opinions, and ate meals with them beneath 
the starry sky!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I kept playing it off, caused everyone 
trouble, and then got saved by all of 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Just like friends! Chasing our dreams 
together with you all—!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"It has become yet another precious 
treasure to me. Thank you...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Tucker-san...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Now, forth! Let us learn the fate of this 
island! Here we goooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After opening the letter, Tucker Brian did 
not move for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: —Ha, haha...! Hahahaha...! Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I did ittt!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Long-term operation has been approved! 
This place has finally been recognized...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay! I did it~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You did it-!! Congratulations, 
Tucker-san!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Ah, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I've always... wanted to help them, in any 
way I could!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
To me, someone sick of a life where, 
despite being an Umamusume, studying was 
all I could do...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
To give back to the Umamusume who gave me 
dreams and vitality—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"No, well... you see! I got a bit too 
carried away! Ha ha ha!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Why not? Let's just say everything you 
want to say."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We're on a deserted island, so there's no 
point in trying to look cool.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...... Haha, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Alright then... without holding back! Let 
me roar with the excitement in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Tucker Brine bolted outside—and 
took a deep breath!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Run, run, Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Carrying our feelings, carrying our 
dreams! With wishes and prayers—toward 
'what lies beyond'!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Let your soul... burnnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Daaahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! One last request, if you'd do 
me the favor! All of youâgive the island 
a proper send-off!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Sing, dance, and train hard! The ultimate 
deserted island live show is now 
underwayyyy~!
